已生成 FRR 配置，请选择保存位置并核对后在对端设备手动应用: FRR configuration generated. Choose a save location, review it and apply it manually on the peer device.

无法访问系统 PF 设备，透明 DNS 未启用；当前配置未更改: The system PF device is unavailable. Transparent DNS is disabled and the configuration is unchanged.
DNS 配置无法启用，已恢复原配置；请检查接口、监听端口和网络后台服务: DNS configuration could not be enabled. The previous configuration was restored. Check interfaces, listen ports and the network service.
真实 DNS 请求失败或超时，请检查上游连通性及源地址绕行策略: Real DNS request failed or timed out. Check upstream connectivity and the source bypass policy.
真实 DNS 上游返回 Fake-IP，请检查源地址绕行策略及 Surge DN: Real DNS upstream returned a Fake-IP. Check source bypass and Surge DNS interception.
Fake-IP 发行未就绪，未返回地址: Fake-IP issuance is not ready. No address was returned.
Surge DNS 请求失败或超时: Surge DNS request failed or timed out

处理期间路由或健康状态发生变化: Routing or health changed during the query
Surge DNS 返回了 Fake-IP 网段之外的地址，未作为 Fake-I: Surge DNS returned an address outside the Fake-IP prefixes. It was not issued as a Fake-IP.
请在对端设备手动应用 FRR 配置，并合并已有邻居和策略；文件不会自动修改网关。: Apply the FRR configuration manually on the peer and merge existing neighbors and policies. The file does not modify the gateway automatically.
导出不代表 BGP 已启用、邻居已建立或路由已安装。: Exporting does not mean BGP is enabled, a session is established or a route is installed.

当前 BGP 未运行；切换 BGP/Hybrid 并启用 BGP 后才能建立邻居: BGP is not running. Switch to BGP/Hybrid and enable BGP to establish a neighbor.

尚未选择 RoutePilot 邻居；请在 RoutePilot 添加 对端 地: No RoutePilot neighbor is selected. Add the peer address and ASN in RoutePilot.

导出的 对端 ASN 或地址族与所选 BGP 邻居不一致: The exported peer ASN or address family does not match the selected neighbor
导出配置使用对端 TCP 179；请先把对应邻居端口改为 179: The export uses peer TCP port 179. Change the corresponding neighbor port to 179 first

将通过 macOS 管理员授权替换后台程序，短暂停止 DNS 服务并释放自己的: macOS administrator authorization will replace the backend program, briefly stop DNS and release its PF rules. The database, keys and settings are retained. Configured transparent interception resumes after restart.
